verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's docs present it as API-first: documents, embeddings, full-text, semantic and conversational search are all exposed "from a single API" (docs-1). Index creation, document ingestion, settings and ranking-rule tuning can all be driven through the API, typed SDKs and the native MCP server (docs-13, docs-43, docs-79, docs-50). A community user confirms creating indexes, uploading documents and changing settings purely in code (comm-10), while the web interface is described only as a starter search UI (docs-74). missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, evidence that Cloud console actions (project creation, team/billing management) are API-accessible, and a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none at standard paths).
